title: Hinomori Shiho — Because Today Is Special〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? I thought she wasn't leaving until later...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Well, whatever...
She'd probably be all over me anyway...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll just put my message inside this envelope. She can read it later.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time...
I need to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's this envelope doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Message
rows.Line:
“Dear Shizuku,
Leo/need will be putting on a Thank You Show for all those who've supported us. I hope you can make it.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Message
rows.Line: “You were there to listen when I wasn't sure if I could actually become a professional musician. I've been able to make it this far because of your support.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Message
rows.Line: “Thank you from the bottom of my heart.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Morning.
Did practice end earlier than usual?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We have our dance routine totally nailed down!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But no Kohane yet...
I should probably wait until they're both here to give them their tickets.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't tell me you forgot to do your homework. I'm not letting you copy mine...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...?
Then, why do you seem so anxious?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is there something you wanna talk to me about...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(So, it's something she can't tell me.
Maybe it has to do with work. Did something happen...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now that Kohane's here, I'll give them their tickets.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure what's bothering Minori, but I hope this cheers her up a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Minori, Kohane...
Got a sec? There's something I wanna give you two.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Minori
rows.Line:
Something you want to give us?
Something you wanna give us?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's these.
Tickets for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's actually meant for everyone who's supported us until now—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I finally got mine!!!
Thank you so much, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait a minute... Finally?
Did you know about this already?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Now it all makes sense...
Shizuku told you about what's happening.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. She said that you're personally handing tickets to the people you're close with... So, um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I started wondering if I was gonna get one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that why you looked so anxious just now?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because you took so long to bring it up that I started getting a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Of course you two were getting tickets...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Get ready for an amazing show.
We promise to make it a good one.
